name: City of New Rochelle
gaps: R1-HIST lot sizes come from a historic district map not online; dimensions follow the comparable R1 district by lot size (side/rear left null, FAR and coverage as bands)
R1-7.5 width (75) and front (25) carry a stray footnote mark in the schedule
RMF-0.7/1.3 side yards depend on wall height; RMF-1.0/1.3/2.0 set no story limit
No minimum lot depth in the schedule; frontage equals the lot-width column

No local freshwater wetland permit chapter, steep slope law, stormwater threshold, or accessory apartment provision found in the City Code index; the zoning code sets a 75 ft wetland setback for buildings and parking (§ 331-19)
RMF-SC 4.0 / RMSC-4 (senior) not covered: county marks them non-residential

wetlands.summary: § 331-19: no building, structure or parking within 75 ft of any tidal or freshwater wetland (water-dependent structures excepted; not applicable behind an existing seawall).

steep_slopes.summary: No steep slope protection law found in the City Code.

trees.summary: Ch. 301 Art. III: tree removal permit for any tree (8 in.+ DBH) on lots of 1 acre or more, for more than 3 trees per 12 months or any specimen tree (24 in.+) on unimproved lots under 1 acre, and on lots under Planning Board review.

stormwater.summary: No local stormwater management chapter found in the City Code index; Ch. 318 lets the City order removal of watercourse obstructions.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment provision found in the residence district use regulations (§§ 331-30 to 331-45).

general.accessory_structures: Not in the required front yard; 6 ft from side and 10 ft from rear lot lines; detached buildings 10 ft from the house (§ 331-45A). Decks under 18 in. may enter yards to 6 ft (side) / 10 ft (rear); sports courts 10 ft; minor structures 3 ft (§ 331-14A).
general.pools: § 331-17: pools at least 20 ft from all lot lines; 4 ft fence plus 48 in. evergreen screen; above-ground pools max 48 in.; filter/pump not in a required yard.
general.notes: Height measured from mean existing grade to the mean of eaves and ridge for pitched roofs (design flood elevation in coastal major subdivisions). Corner lots: owner picks the front; other street yard 25 ft (R1-20/15/10/WF-10), 20 ft (R1-10A, R1-7.5, RMF-0.5/0.7/1.3) or 15 ft (R2-7.0, RMF-0.4) (§ 331-14B).

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious surfaces incl. structures, parking, driveways, sidewalks, terraces

max_floor_area.note: Gross floor area excludes stories mostly below grade, unenclosed porches, spaces under 5 ft clear, mechanical space, unfinished attics with pull-down access, and up to 600 sf of enclosed garage in one-family districts

R1 - 20.notes: Schedule lists a single 25 ft side yard (no combined minimum). Other uses: side/rear 60 ft.
